scores.tell: Soft broad sheen on rim and gentle form turn match real; only the clean uniform contact shadow at the bottom is slightly flat.
Clean metal truss highlights are a bit sharp and glossy; the lamp barrel is nicely smooth. Shading is slightly more rendered than the real cards.
Barrel, boots and glove highlights are a bit hard, and the shading is more rendered than the real cards, though the cast shadow is credible.
Soft fin turn is good, but the highlight is a broad gloss and the shadow is very light.
Soft bottle form turn with a gentle sheen. The bright white hot spots on the shoulder are slightly plasticky.
The black cauldron has a glossy rim sheen and deep rendered shading. The floor has crisp, hard tile edges and a dark cast shadow, which looks more like a render than the real cards.
White body with soft turn but crisp specular dots on the wheel hubs and a hard cast shadow on the ground. Looks more like a 3D render.
Leaf clusters are painted with sharp per-leaf highlights and shadows. This reads as texture-heavy, and the lighting is more painterly than the smooth real cards.
The posts have a soft cylindrical turn. The water caustics and sparkles add busy specular detail that the real cards avoid.
Light and shading across the wood look a bit noisy and rendered. Highlights are scattered across the planks rather than a clean sheen.
